headline: Nuclear power releases the energy binding atoms together—incredible power from tiny amounts of matter
universal_truth: Concentrated power brings concentrated consequences; high leverage means high stakes
fun_facts: One uranium pellet the size of a fingertip contains as much energy as 17,000 cubic feet of natural gas
Nuclear plants generate about 10% of world electricity with zero carbon emissions during operation
The energy in atoms comes from the strong nuclear force—the most powerful force in nature
discussion_questions: Where do you use 'nuclear' approaches—high power, high stakes?
How do you manage the risks that come with concentrated power?
When is high-leverage appropriate versus dangerous?

hook.script: A tiny uranium pellet contains as much energy as a ton of coal. Nuclear fission splits atoms, releasing the force that holds matter together. Incredible power from almost nothing—but with equally incredible consequences if mishandled.

cliff.script: Nuclear power is controversial precisely because of its concentrated nature. High power, high stakes. What does this tradeoff teach us?

options.text: Concentrated power brings concentrated consequences—high leverage amplifies both benefits and risks; the same capability that produces abundant energy can produce catastrophic accidents
options.response: Yes. Nuclear is either incredibly efficient or incredibly dangerous—sometimes both. Leverage amplifies everything. High-power approaches require high-quality safeguards.

options.text: Nuclear is just another energy source
options.response: Another source, but its concentration makes it qualitatively different in both promise and peril...

fact1.title: Leverage Amplifies
fact1.script: Nuclear amplifies everything—efficiency and danger, power and consequence. A coal plant failure is a problem. A nuclear plant failure is a catastrophe. Leverage magnifies outcomes in both directions.

fact2.title: Safeguards Required
fact2.script: High-power systems require high-quality safeguards. Nuclear plants have elaborate safety systems precisely because the stakes are so high. Power without appropriate controls is recklessness.

fact3.title: Personal High Stakes
fact3.script: You use high-leverage approaches too—debt, specialization, key relationships. These amplify outcomes. Great when they work, devastating when they fail. Match your safeguards to your stakes.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Concentrated power brings concentrated consequences. High leverage means high stakes. Match your safeguards to your power.

outro.script: That's Day 277. Tomorrow, we'll explore using less power—efficiency. Until then, consider where you're using high-leverage approaches.

growTrack.title: Leverage Audit - Where Are Your High Stakes?
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify high-leverage situations and ensure appropriate safeguards
growTrack.activity: Where are you using 'nuclear' approaches—high leverage, concentrated power? Debt? Key dependencies? Critical relationships? Do you have adequate safeguards for these high-stakes areas? Leverage amplifies; prepare accordingly.
